name: Brightwater Lake
summary: Across Tirisfal's lowlands, Brightwater Lake lies cold and dark northeast of Brill. Once a retreat for Lordaeron, it now surrounds an island where a lone necromancer conducts forbidden research.

sections.title: Waters of the North
sections.body: Brightwater Lake spreads across northern Tirisfal between Brill and the Scarlet Watch Post. Under the Kingdom of Lordaeron, its shores offered a quiet country haven. That peace is gone. The Plaguelands lie to the east, and grey skies hang over the lake's murky, chilled waters. Withered trees line the shore, where murlocs and hostile undead roam.

sections.title: The Hermit's Refuge
sections.body: Gunther Arcanus lives apart from others on the island retreat at the heart of Brightwater Lake. He broke free of the Lich King's control alone, yet believes every other undead remains a Scourge slave. Undead servants guard his retreat. Bethor Iceshard hopes to show his old friend that the Forsaken can choose their own path. When an adventurer proves opposition to the Scourge, Gunther agrees to join the Forsaken.

faq.answer: Brightwater Lake lies in northeastern Tirisfal Glades, just northeast of Brill. It is south of the jagged North Coast and west of the Scarlet Watch Post, which guards the mountain passes toward the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Who lives on the island in the middle of the lake?
faq.answer: Gunther Arcanus lives on the central island, known as Gunther's Retreat, with his undead servants. The Forsaken in Brill and the Undercity have taken an interest in him.

faq.q: What threats are found around the waters?
faq.answer: Aggressive vile fins and murlocs scavenge along the shore. Undead servants guard Gunther Arcanus's island against intruders.

faq.q: Why do the guards in Brill talk about a summer camp here?
faq.answer: Brill's deathguards joke that the Forsaken tried to run a children's summer camp on Brightwater Lake's shores. They say masked psychos terrorized the grounds until it had to close, a grim local twist on human campfire tales.

angles.text: As Forsaken, you must secure Brightwater Lake to defend Brill's eastern approaches. You must also learn whether the independent necromancer Gunther Arcanus will be an asset or an enemy.
As a mage, you can find unusual, unguided mastery on the lake's island in the renegade wizard Gunther Arcanus.
